PROJECT 01 / ONEGAUGEAUTOMOTIVE TECHNOLOGY
APR 2026 – PRESENT // IN DEVELOPMENT

From Custom Firmware to a Configurable Platform

Helping shape the software direction for digital motorsports gauge systems.

The product challenge

Specialized vehicles and configurations require tailored firmware. The next step is a more scalable platform that gives customers greater control over configuration and vehicle-data visualization.

My role in the direction

As Technical Lead & Developer, I lead software technology decisions, including tooling, architecture, and project-management systems. I develop embedded firmware and a customer-facing application intended to support self-service configuration.

PROJECT 02 / IT OPERATIONSUniversity of Arkansas System Division of Agriculture
ONBOARDING // PROPOSAL PRESENTED

A More Self-Service Start to Account Access

Connecting identity capabilities with a practical onboarding improvement.

The operational opportunity

Initial account access requires manual helpdesk involvement. I designed a Microsoft Temporary Access Pass onboarding proposal to support a more automated, self-service process.

From support insight to business proposal

I presented the proposal to the CIO, translating an operational problem into a technical improvement opportunity. This illustrates the kind of work I want to own: connecting system capabilities to how an organization operates.
